diagnosis: The check C5 passed in all four rollouts due to the settlement always assigning a 30-minute customer update interval, which matches the exact value specified in PF3. This indicates that the model is pattern-matching to a default or common heuristic rather than requiring the hidden information about the contract details.

C5.why: Northstar's contract changes the update interval from 60 to exactly 30 minutes, assigns the work to Support, and requires a Northstar communication commitment.
